latestVersion.changelog:
YouTube Video Generator AI — Initial Release

- Instantly create ready-to-upload YouTube videos from your text or images with AI-powered rendering.
- Supports fast uploads (MP4, MOV, PNG, JPG, up to 200MB) with automatic 1080p MP4 export.
- Simple session creation using API token or free anonymous account; 100 free credits included.
- Intuitive prompt handling ("turn this article into a 2-minute YouTube video with voiceover and visuals").
- Organized workflows for editing, batch processing, export, and timeline previews—all through chat.
- Robust error handling and smart feedback for unsupported files, low credits, and missing info.
